from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of the beginning cash balance extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in this filing")
    balance_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the beginning cash balance as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    balance_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written in the document")
    balance_date: str | None = Field(description="The date this balance represents (e.g., 'December 31, 2023')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_records: list[CashBalanceRecord]
